item.title: Tracking goals
item.description:
[[You can’t optimise what you can’t see]].

I have ambitions and targets I want to hit. Most people do. But keeping an eye on them hasn’t always been my forte.

Looking back

Previously set goals were always:

  • short lived,
  • too ambitious,
  • poorly defined,
  • or [[The goals were not goals to begin with|the goals aren’t goals to begin with]].
